data.name: AllowOverwriteDescription
data.value: If unchecked, upscaling will be skipped for videos that already exist in the output path. If checked, any videos that already exist in the output path will be overwritten without warning. Use with caution.

data.name: AllowOverwriteLabel
data.value: Allow Videos in Output Path to be Overwritten

data.name: AppNotInstalledText
data.value: App is not installed; auto update settings unavailable.

data.name: AutoUpdateDescription
data.value: Whether to automatically check for and install app updates.

data.name: DownloadUpdateButtonText
data.value: 更新をダウンロードする

data.name: EnableInterpolationDescription
data.value: Whether or not to run video frame interpolation.

data.name: EnsembleDescription
data.value: Whether or not to use the ensemble version of the model, which improves quality but runs slower.

data.name: FfmpegOutputSettingsDescription
data.value: Video encoding settings to pass to FFmpeg. Choose a preset below or edit the text to use custom settings.

data.name: FfmpegPresetsDescriptionLossless
data.value: FFV1 lossless compression, usually fastest to encode but extremely large filesize, and may be slower if bottlenecked by a slow storage drive.

data.name: FfmpegPresetsDescriptionNvencHevc
data.value: HEVC compression with NVENC, fast encode using GPU but lower quality than CPU encoding.

data.name: FfmpegPresetsDescriptionX264
data.value: x264 compression, OK compression, faster to encode.

data.name: FfmpegPresetsDescriptionX265
data.value: x265 compression, more efficient compression but slower to encode.

data.name: FinalResizeFactorDescription
data.value: Resize the video by this factor after running all models. The video width and height are scaled by this percentage, so a value of 100% performs no resize, and a value of 50% cuts the width and height of the video in half. This setting is ignored if Final Resize Height is specified. Note that the final video width and height must be divisble by 2 or the output video will be invalid.

data.name: FinalResizeHeightDescription
data.value: Resize the video to this height after running all models, set to 0 to disable. Note that the final video width and height must be divisble by 2 or the output video will be invalid.

data.name: FirstTimeSetupText
data.value: Performing first time setup. This may take several minutes...

data.name: InputFolderDescription
data.value: Path of the folder to upscale. The folder will be scanned and all video files (.mkv, .mp4, .mov, .webm, .avi, .mpg, .vob, .ts, .m2ts and other common formats) found will be upscaled.

data.name: InputVideoDescription
data.value: Path of the video file to upscale.

data.name: InterpolationFactorDescription
data.value: Interpolation factor represented as a fraction. For example, 2 / 1 will double the framerate.

data.name: InterpolationModelDescription
data.value: Interpolation model to run. Higher RIFE version is newer and usually better quality.

data.name: OnnxModelPathDescription
data.value: File path of the ONNX model to run.

data.name: OutputFilenameDescription
data.value: The filename of the upscaled video, including the desired file extension. %filename% is the input filename without extension.

data.name: OutputFolderDescription
data.value: Path of the folder to save the upscaled video files.

data.name: ResizeFactorBeforeUpscaleDescription
data.value: Resize the video by this factor before running this model. The video width and height are scaled by this percentage, so a value of 100% performs no resize, and a value of 50% cuts the width and height of the video in half. This setting is ignored if Resize Height Before Upscale is specified.

data.name: ResizeHeightBeforeUpscaleDescription
data.value: Resize the video to this height before running this model, set to 0 to disable.

data.name: SceneDetectionThresholdDescription
data.value: Scene detection is used to prevent interpolating frames during hard transitions between scenes. The threshold adjusts the sensitivity for what is considered a scene change. If the threshold is too high, more interpolation artifacts may be visible during scene transitions. If the threshold is too low, the video may stutter more.

data.name: SelectFolderButtonText
data.value: フォルダーを選択する

data.name: TensorRtEngineSettingsAutoDescription
data.value: The appropriate TensorRT engine settings will be determined automatically based on the selected models. In most cases this shouldn't need to be changed.

data.name: UpscalingBackendDescriptionDirectMl
data.value: Works on any DirectX 12 GPU (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) but slower than TensorRT. Output is 4:2:0. ONNX models must be opset 21 or lower (higher opsets fall back to the CPU, which is extremely slow).

data.name: UpscalingBackendDescriptionNcnn
data.value: Compatible with NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs but typically slower than DirectML. Supports fp32 ONNX models only.

data.name: UpscalingBackendDescriptionTensorRt
data.value: Fastest option but NVIDIA only. Supports fp16 and fp32 ONNX models. fp16 models are recommended for faster performance and reduced VRAM usage without any loss in quality. The initial engine generation may require several minutes but only needs to be done once.

data.name: WorkflowsTooltip
data.value: Workflows provide convenient access to save and load preset settings for upscaling.

data.name: DeinterlaceIvtcDescription

data.name: DeinterlaceBwdifDescription
